rule.partially_evaluable_axis: average all finite threshold cell scores for that species-axis
rule.no_evaluable_threshold_for_species_axis: uninformative evidence; set axis likelihood ratio to 1 (axis log evidence 0) for that species rather than treating it as support or contradiction
rule.species_with_at_least_two_finite_axes: center and RMS-standardize finite axis scores, convert finite scores to normalized evidence, and leave unavailable axes at neutral LR=1
rule.species_with_fewer_than_two_finite_axes_: all 96 axes receive neutral LR=1 for that species
rule.reason: Geographic support may make a candidate boundary unevaluable. Absence of evaluability is not evidence against a shared boundary.
